Last updated: June 2026

GLAZE ("we", "us") respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains what personal information we collect, how we use and share it, and the choices you have. It applies to the GLAZE website and related sales channels.

1. Information we collect

Information you give us: name, email address, shipping and billing address, phone number, order and payment details (processed securely by our payment provider — we never store full card numbers), and any messages you send us.

Information collected automatically: device and browser type, IP address, pages viewed, referring links and similar usage data, gathered through cookies and similar technologies (including our ecommerce platform and analytics tools).

Information from third parties: our payment processor, shipping carriers, and marketing or advertising partners may share limited information with us to help fulfil orders, prevent fraud and improve our marketing.

2. How we use your information

  • To process, fulfil and deliver your orders and provide customer support.
  • To take payment and protect against fraud and abuse.
  • To send you transactional messages about your orders.
  • To send marketing — restock alerts, offers and news — where you have opted in. You can unsubscribe at any time.
  • To operate, analyse and improve the Site and our products.
  • To meet our legal, tax and accounting obligations.

3. Legal bases for processing

Where the GDPR or similar laws apply, we process your data on the basis of: performance of our contract with you (to fulfil orders), your consent (for marketing and certain cookies), our legitimate interests (to run and improve the business and prevent fraud), and compliance with legal obligations.

4. Cookies and tracking

We use cookies and similar technologies to keep the Site working, remember your cart, understand how the Site is used, and — with your consent where required — to measure and personalise marketing. You can control cookies through your browser settings; disabling some cookies may affect how the Site works.

5. How we share information

We share personal information only with: service providers who help us run the shop (our ecommerce platform, payment processors, shipping carriers, email and analytics providers); authorities or advisors where required by law or to protect our rights; and a successor entity in the event of a merger, acquisition or sale of assets. We do not sell your personal information.

6. Data retention

We keep personal information only for as long as needed to fulfil the purposes described here, including to meet legal, tax and reporting requirements, after which it is deleted or anonymised.

7. Security

We use appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your information. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.

8. Your rights

Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct, delete or receive a copy of your personal information, to object to or restrict certain processing, and to withdraw consent. If you are in California, you may have the right to know, delete and opt out of the sale or sharing of personal information, and not to be discriminated against for exercising those rights. To make a request, email hello@glaze.shop; we may need to verify your identity.

9. International transfers

Your information may be processed in countries other than where you live, including by our service providers. Where required, we put safeguards in place to protect it.

10. Children's privacy

The Site is not intended for children, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from anyone under 16. If you believe a child has provided us information, contact us and we will delete it.

11. Marketing choices

You can opt out of marketing emails at any time using the unsubscribe link in any message or by contacting us. We will still send you essential messages about your orders.

12. Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time; the version on this page is current and changes take effect when posted.

13. Contact us

For any privacy question or request, email hello@glaze.shop.

This policy is a template provided as a starting point. Please review it with a qualified professional and adapt it to your business and local laws (such as GDPR or CCPA) before relying on it.
